name: Ironmaster's Agent

intro.text: A steam engine on rails! Haul ten tons of iron nearly ten miles? I'll bet you five hundred guineas, no, I'll bet my reputation, that it breaks down before Quaker's Yard.

win: Hmph. The wager's lost. Don't tell the ironmaster I said it was impressive.
after: A steam engine is the future. Don't tell the horses.
